_comment: Seed fixture for the ai-recommended-actions-htmx widget-type bead.
Created for ka-0000000272 (Phase 4 free-htmx port — fifth port after
activity-log-htmx, MR !2334 / ka-0000004584; related-tickets-htmx,
MR !2346 / ka-0000005540; header-incident-summary-htmx, MR !2347 /
ka-0000005304; and reproduction-steps-htmx, MR !2350 /
ka-0000007835). Strategy A — port-then-soak: lives alongside the
Go-coded `ai-recommended-actions` slug rather than replacing it.
Authoring path:
kd create 'Free-htmx widget: ai-recommended-actions-htmx' \
--type=widget-type \
-F gardenio/controller/cmd/beads-viewer/fixtures/ai-recommended-actions-htmx.json
Pre-write hooks (kbeads/internal/server/widget_validation.go) parse
template_source under html/template and reject malformed inputs at
createBead/updateBead time, so a bad fixture surfaces immediately.
Schema validation runs against widget-instance writes per the same
pre-write hook; the schema below is the wire contract.
The wire contract mirrors the Go-coded `ai-recommended-actions`
renderer at widgets_phase4.go::renderAIRecommendedActions —
actions[] of {headline, detail, confidence, hotkey, ...}. Two
intentional parity gaps vs. the Go path, both documented in
TestAIRecommendedActionsParity:
1. Confidence normalisation. The Go path runs payload.confidence
through confidenceBand() which (a) maps numeric scores to
band strings (>=0.8 high, >=0.5 medium, otherwise low) and
(b) lower-cases string bands and rejects anything outside
{high, medium, low}. The htmx template body has no Go-side
hook, so producers cutting an ai-recommended-actions-htmx
widget-instance MUST emit confidence as a pre-banded lower-
case string (`"high"` / `"medium"` / `"low"`) — numeric
scores would render verbatim and violate D2.
2. Action buttons. The Go renderer builds Investigate-style
`<button class="ii-action-btn">` elements from
OpenMRAction / OpenJiraAction / OpenMezmoAction descriptors
keyed off open_mr / open_jira / open_mezmo. The htmx template
body cannot reach those helpers, so the optional button-
construction fields are ignored. Buttons are a parity gap
locked in TestAIRecommendedActionsParity.

fields.template_source:
{{- $actions := index .Payload "actions" -}} {{if $actions}}
    {{range $actions}}
  1. {{if .hotkey}}{{.hotkey}}{{end}} {{.headline}} {{if .confidence}}{{.confidence}} confidence{{end}}
    {{if .detail}}

    {{.detail}}

    {{end}}
    2. {{end}}
{{else}}

No recommended actions.

{{end}}
